title: feat(objectql): a nested-relation condition on a read verb is one read-scoped in-database subquery per relationship, up to three, where it is provably the same read as the id read
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DWLrF6ZURGN6BVpSbuDyHTg)_

Part of #33626 — the engine and analytics halves land here; the card stays open until #33876 lands maintainer ruling Q2 (the engine's `INVALID_FILTER` / 400 for MongoDB / OData, with the ADR-0139 capability bit). The other parts are their own follow-up cards citing #33626 and its rulings: #33875 (skills text, Tier H), #33876 (above, Tier H), #33877 (multi-valued relation as a JSON-membership semi-join), #33878 (a dataset measure's own `filter`).

Clause-②: yes (widening) — `{ account: { status: { $ne: 'cancelled' } } }` on `find`, `findOne`, `count` and `aggregate` (and so every analytics face that hands the engine the nested form) is served whatever the number of matching related records on a driver that compiles the subquery (the SQL drivers; the in-memory driver evaluates it in process), where more than 1,000 answered `INVALID_FILTER` / 400. The related read is planned through its whole pipeline as the caller and its final `where` becomes the subquery's scope; related-object read restrictions are carried into the subquery, or the hop falls back to the id read (the related object read as the caller, then `$in`, under the 1,000 cap), unchanged. A relation key inside the condition may now carry a condition of its own, down to ADR-0071's three relationships (`{ contact: { account: { region: { name: 'NA' } } } }`), where a second level answered `INVALID_FILTER` / 400; each hop is that object's own read, and a fourth relationship is refused by name. On the analytics engine-aggregate path a dotted `where` leaf through up to three relationships (`order.customer.tier`), and a cross-object leaf in a compiled dataset's own definition-level `filter`, reach the engine as that nested condition, where both answered `INVALID_FIELD` / 400. Unchanged, still the id read: a related object on another datasource, a driver that compiles no subquery (MongoDB, OData), a related object an object-scoped middleware or an `afterFind` hook shapes, a multi-valued relation and the `update` / `delete` verbs. A per-measure `filter` carrying a cross-object leaf stays refused. The SQL echo of a dataset `filter` carrying a served cross-object leaf refuses `INVALID_FILTER` / 400 where it refused `INVALID_FIELD` / 400; neither printed a statement.
Metadata-protocol: added — a compiled dataset's definition-level `filter` (`@objectstack/service-analytics`) now accepts a cross-object leaf on the engine-aggregate path, where it answered `INVALID_FIELD` / 400: a new accepted value for a dataset author.
Skills-docs: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/query-syntax.mdx` and `content/docs/kernel/contracts/data-engine.mdx` describe the subquery, the three-relationship limit, where the id read and its cap still apply and which drivers compile the subquery. `skills/objectstack-query` still says "up to 1000 related ids" and one level for every relation; that is now stricter than the engine for a single-valued relation on a read verb (a follow-up skills-only change, governed).

Area-lease pilot #33059, area A3. Review#2 (FAIL on `cad68d07`) is answered on this head: every finding is addressed below.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：读操作（find/findOne/count/aggregate）里的单值关系条件，只在「可证明与原 id 读取完全相同」时才走库内子查询（无 1000 上限）；其余情况（另一个数据源、不编译子查询的驱动如 MongoDB/OData、关联对象有对象级中间件或 afterFind 钩子、未到达驱动调用等）一律回到 main 原有的「以调用者身份读 id 再 `$in`、上限 1000」，行为不变。关系条件可嵌套到 3 层；分析路径的多跳点号 where 与数据集自身 `filter` 走同一条路。
- 为什么改：评审 #2 指出子查询未完整承载关联对象的读限制、并在若干场景把原先可用的请求变成 400/500；按席位裁决，子查询只在可证明等同时采用，其余全部回退。
- 风险与回滚：关联对象的读限制要么进入子查询，要么该跳回退；每种回退都有钉住用例，并在真实 SQLite 与 PG 16 上跑过。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/objectql/src/relation-semi-join.ts`（何时规划、何时回退）、`packages/objectql/src/engine-readable-ids-permission-formula.ts`（边界处的回退读）、`packages/objectql/src/engine-query-lowering.ts`（与 main 相同的 id 读）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest exec vitest run src/data-nested-object-door.test.ts`，预期全部通过（PG 单元需 `OS_TEST_POSTGRES_URL`，未设时跳过）。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地（卡片保持打开，等 #33876）。

## What changes

- **The semi-join is taken only where it is provably the same read as the id read.** For a single-valued relation condition on a read verb, the engine plans the related object's read — the very `find` the id read runs (same condition, projection, limit and caller context) — stopped at its driver call, and composes its final `where` as a `ReadableIds` subquery leaf. Related-object read restrictions are carried into the subquery or the hop falls back. Every other case is main's id read, unchanged (the related ids read as the caller, then `$in`, with the 1,000 cap): a related object on another datasource; a driver that compiles no subquery (MongoDB, OData, any driver not on the engine's compiling list — the SQL drivers compile it, the in-memory driver evaluates it in process); a related object with an object-keyed middleware or an `afterFind` hook; and a related read that did not reach exactly one driver call or came back with rows. No new 400 and no new 500: the cross-datasource refusal and the driver's ADR-0139 refusal this PR introduced on `cad68d07` are gone, and the object-keyed-middleware case is served as on main.
- **Up to three relationships** (unchanged from the previous push): `admitRelationCondition` admits a relation key inside the condition, recursively, to `RELATION_CONDITION_MAX_HOPS` = 3 (ADR-0071); each hop is its object's own read, planned or id-read by the same rules; a fourth relationship is refused `INVALID_FILTER` / 400 (`hop-limit`).
- **Analytics** (unchanged behaviour): on the engine-aggregate path a dotted `where` leaf through up to three relationships, and a cross-object leaf in a compiled dataset's own definition-level `filter`, reach the engine as the nested condition. The SQL-echo refusal copy no longer describes an id match and a cap.
- **The "no usable security service" warning** is reported (and its once-only slot spent) only for a read with a leaf that asks the service; a read whose leaves are all planned asks nothing.
- Docs: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/query-syntax.mdx`, `content/docs/kernel/contracts/data-engine.mdx`; module docblocks.

## Tests

All counts on head `96c23127` unless marked; local box, shared verify lock.

- `@objectstack/objectql` full suite: **597/597 files, 13188/13188 tests** (`96c23127`).
- `packages/objectql/src/engine-nested-relation-lowering.test.ts`: 24/24, including the new describe "the semi-join falls back to the id read wherever it is not provably that read" — MongoDB / OData / unlisted driver keep the id read and its cap, an object-keyed middleware, an `afterFind` hook, a global middleware that shortens or appends (the mask-style map stays planned, CONTROL), a far datasource, differing read options at the boundary (CONTROL: the same options compose), and the warning pin.
- `packages/rest/src/data-nested-object-door.test.ts`: SQLite cell 12 passed (MySQL cell skipped, no server); with a private PostgreSQL 16 cluster (`OS_TEST_POSTGRES_URL`) **24 passed / 12 skipped** — new describe with two tenants through one hop and through three hops (find, two-step parity, count) and an after-driver read rule (`afterFind` on the related object) answering as the two-step read does.
- `@objectstack/service-analytics`: 215/215 files (5218 passed, 335 skipped).
- Dependents sweep (`turbo run test --filter=...^@objectstack/objectql`, i.e. every downstream consumer of objectql, `@object-ui/*` and dogfood excluded and run separately): 51 packages, 121/121 tasks green on `3194cbae`; later commits touch only `engine.ts` (a private method replacing an inline host object) and two test files.
- Full dogfood battery on `96c23127`: **Test Files 467 passed / 3 skipped (470), Tests 3959 passed / 42 skipped (4001)**, no failures; lock `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- Typecheck (`tsc --noEmit` plus `check:test-typecheck`) for objectql, rest, service-analytics: exit 0. ESLint `--no-inline-config` on every changed TS file: exit 0.

<details><summary>Ablation (one-shot, not kept)</summary>

The fallback line in `packages/objectql/src/relation-semi-join.ts` (`plannedRelationLeafVerdict`, the `sameReadDriverOptions` check) was replaced with `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (blob `8af07e04` to `8faa8533`), objectql rebuilt, `ablation-dist-preflight.mjs` confirmed the marker in `dist/` (4 files). Red: objectql 1/24 (the differing-options pin); rest "one hop" and "three hops" both red. Restore: blob equals `HEAD`, `git diff HEAD` empty, rebuilt, preflight `--absent` ok; objectql and rest green again. A first attempt used a string-literal marker that esbuild constant-folded (preflight exit 1), so that run was void and was redone with a property-access marker.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- driver-memory serves the form in process (maintainer ruling Q1 on #33626, comment 6889549817).
- MongoDB / OData now keep main's capped id read (no refusal); the ruled engine `INVALID_FILTER` / 400 and the ADR-0139 capability bit are #33876, which is why this PR is `Part of`. Until that bit exists the engine plans the subquery only for the drivers it names; a driver registered under a datasource name keeps the id read.
- A related object on another datasource keeps main's id read (no new 400) — listed as unchanged.
- `skills/objectstack-query` still teaches "up to 1000 related ids" and one level (governed, #33875).
- The echo of a dataset `filter` carrying a served cross-object leaf refuses `INVALID_FILTER` (it refused `INVALID_FIELD` before); both are 400 refusals of a statement that cannot be printed.
- N2 (one hop-limit constant for objectql and service-analytics) is not in this PR: `@objectstack/objectql` is only a devDependency of `@objectstack/service-analytics`, so sharing the constant needs a runtime dependency or a `@objectstack/spec` export, both contract changes beyond a nit; the two stay tied by their docblocks.
